sentence_stem: Although the story seemed simple at first,
correct_completion: it revealed a deeper meaning by the final page.
full_sentence: Although the story seemed simple at first, it revealed a deeper meaning by the final page.
acceptable_variants: it became far more complex than expected.

options.text: so the author never explained the ending.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' signals contrast, but this clause describes a consequence. It does not contrast with the story seeming simple.

options.text: it revealed a deeper meaning by the final page.
the characters were all sitting in a garden.
options.why_wrong: This adds a detail about setting, but it does not provide the contrasting development expected after 'although'.

options.text: because the author wrote it in the past.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a cause, not a contrast. 'Although' requires a clause that goes against the first part of the sentence.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must contrast with the first part of the sentence. Here the story looks simple, so the completion should show that it has a deeper meaning. Learners often confuse concessive connectors with causal ones, so check which relationship the connector signals.
